scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,tv,tablet -c blue,magenta,green "bun run --cwd socket-server dev" "bun run --cwd tv-nextjs dev" "bun run --cwd tablet-nextjs dev"
scripts.dev:with-mock: concurrently -k -n server,mock,tv,tablet -c blue,yellow,magenta,green "bun run --cwd socket-server dev" "bun run --cwd socket-server mock:hardware" "bun run --cwd tv-nextjs dev" "bun run --cwd tablet-nextjs dev"
scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd socket-server && bun install --cwd tablet-nextjs && bun install --cwd tv-nextjs
